id: \bWe'll take the Pokémon from every universe.
en: \bWe'll take the Pokémon from every universe.

id: \bGoh: I'll handle these guys. Hurry on ahead.
en: \bGoh: I'll handle these guys. Hurry on ahead.
it: \bGoh: Ci penso io a questi tizi. Tu vai avanti, svelto.

id: \bGoh: There you are. I was able to catch Ninetales. I'm now an official member of Project Mew.
en: \bGoh: There you are. I was able to catch Ninetales.  I'm now an official member of Project Mew.
it: \bGoh: Eccoti qui. Sono riuscito a catturare Ninetales.  Ora sono un membro ufficiale del Progetto Mew.

id: \bThanks for coming with me. Just having you along helped boost my confidence. We should head back to the lab though. It's freezing up here.
en: \bThanks for coming with me. Just having you along helped boost my confidence. We should head back to the lab though. It's freezing up here.
it: \bGrazie per essere venuto con me. Averti al mio fianco mi ha dato più fiducia. Però dovremmo tornare al laboratorio. Si gela quassù.

id: \rI guess battling gets loud. I need to stop.
en: \rI guess battling gets loud. I need to stop.
it: \rIn effetti le lotte sono rumorose. Devo smettere.

id: \rHello. The cave is dangerous so I'm using my Abra to teleport people past it. Want to be teleported to Hearthome City?
en: \rHello. The cave is dangerous so I'm using my Abra to teleport people past it. Want to be teleported to Hearthome City?
it: \rCiao. La grotta è pericolosa, quindi uso il mio Abra per teletrasportare la gente oltre. Vuoi essere teletrasportato a Cuoripoli?

id: \rOkay, but I'm still not letting you in.
en: \rOkay, but I'm still not letting you in.
it: \rVa bene, ma comunque non ti faccio entrare.

id: \rCynthia: That's it! We've thwarted their plans.
en: \rCynthia: That's it! We've thwarted their plans.
it: \rCamilla: Ecco fatto! Abbiamo sventato i loro piani.

id: \bSaturn: No! Noooo! Our boss needs to return.
en: \bSaturn: No! Noooo! Our boss needs to return.
it: \bSaturno: No! Nooo! Il nostro capo deve tornare.

id: \rThank you, everyone, for your help. I'll take care of turning in these criminals.
en: \rThank you, everyone, for your help. I'll take care of turning in these criminals.
it: \rGrazie a tutti per l'aiuto. Mi occuperò io di consegnare questi criminali.

id: \bGoh: I guess that's it. Let's head back to the lab.
en: \bGoh: I guess that's it. Let's head back to the lab.
it: \bGoh: Direi che è finita. Torniamo al laboratorio.

id: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Sophocles:
en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Sophocles:
it: Rotom Phone: chiamata in arrivo da Chrys:

id: \bSophocles: \PN. Could you do me a favor and visit me at the Mossdeep Space Center. I need your help.
en: \bSophocles: \PN. Could you do me a favor and visit me at the Mossdeep Space Center. I need your help.
it: \bChrys: \PN. Potresti farmi un favore e venire a trovarmi al Centro Spaziale di Verdeazzupoli? Ho bisogno del tuo aiuto.

id: \bSaturn: I've tried again and again to bring our beloved boss back. You were the reason he left us. I will not let you stop his return!
en: \bSaturn: I've tried again and again to bring our beloved boss back. You were the reason he left us. I will not let you stop his return!
it: \bSaturno: Ho provato più e più volte a riportare indietro il nostro amato capo. Tu sei il motivo per cui ci ha lasciati. Non ti permetterò di impedire il suo ritorno!

id: \rThe cold helps me train. The height doesn't.
en: \rThe cold helps me train. The height doesn't.
it: \rIl freddo mi aiuta ad allenarmi. L'altitudine no.

id: \rJupiter: We're going to bring our boss back.
en: \rJupiter: We're going to bring our boss back.

id: \bBe careful walking around. A sudden slip and it is over.
en: \bBe careful walking around. A sudden slip and it is over.
it: \bAttento a dove cammini. Basta una scivolata e sei spacciato.

id: \rMars: Heatran will open the way to Cyrus.
en: \rMars: Heatran will open the way to Cyrus.
it: \rMartes: Heatran aprirà la strada verso Cyrus.

id: \rMars: Boss Cyrus will unite us once again.
en: \rMars: Boss Cyrus will unite us once again.
it: \rMartes: Il capo Cyrus ci unirà ancora una volta.

id: \bGoh: I think so. Let's get back into the portal before it closes.
en: \bGoh: I think so. Let's get back into the portal before it closes.
it: \bGoh: Credo di sì. Torniamo nel portale prima che si chiuda.
\bNon mi sento più le dita dei piedi.

id: \bWe planned for too long for this to fail.
en: \bWe planned for too long for this to fail.
it: \bAbbiamo pianificato troppo a lungo perché fallisca.

id: \bI didn't know you were with Goh. My mistake.
en: \bI didn't know you were with Goh. My mistake.
it: \bNon sapevo fossi con Goh. Errore mio.
